---
title: "Week 4: Numerical Analysis and 3D Plotting"
---

## Official Topic

MATLAB built-in numerical analysis and 3D plotting.

## Problem Focus

When exact solutions are hard or impossible, how do we compute approximate answers responsibly?

Students use root-finding, numerical integration, and 3D plotting as tools for understanding approximation.

## In Class

- Solve scalar equations numerically.
- Approximate integrals.
- Visualize functions of two variables.
- Discuss initial guesses, numerical tolerance, and graphical checks.

## AI-Aware Task

Ask an LLM to solve an equation numerically. Then verify the returned root by substituting it back into the equation and plotting the function near the root.
